title: Console: Route Experiments list + details pages (MVP) behind feature flag
author: Felix Schneider
description: Summary: Adds the initial Console UI surfaces for Route Experiments (A/B/n) management: an experiments list view and a per-experiment details view. Both pages are gated behind the `route_experiments_ui` feature flag and require existing Rollouts access (RBAC checks are enforced server-side; UI will show permission-aware affordances). The goal of this PR is to land the navigation + MVP read-only visualization (status + guardrail readouts) so we can iterate with Design and wire in creation + editing flows in follow-ups. What’s included: (1) /console/rollouts/experiments route entry (hidden unless flag enabled) (2) Experiments list table with filtering/sorting: status, route, created_by, start/stop timestamps, active variants count (3) Experiment details page with: summary header, current state, traffic split read-only card, guardrails snapshot (latency/cost/error) and last evaluation time, and quick links to dashboards (Grafana) (4) Empty states and error states (flag off, no permissions, API errors) (5) Basic status mapping and UI copy aligned with UX spec. What’s not included (follow-ups): experiment creation wizard (DES-311/ENG-9025 follow-up), editing allocations, results charts/deltas API integration (see PR-28644/PR-28658), audit/change history, and any statistical significance UI. Implementation notes: - Data comes from Console backend endpoints introduced in PR-28511. This UI only uses list + get-by-id endpoints; it does not attempt to compute results locally. - Guardrail readouts are intentionally “snapshot style”: we show current thresholds + most recent evaluation state returned by the API. We do not render time series here yet to avoid expensive queries and keep the initial surface fast. - Statuses: Draft, Scheduled, Running, Degraded (soft-stop requested), Stopping (drain), Stopped, Archived. The mapping is centralized in `experiments/status.ts` so backend state machine changes are contained. - Feature flag: `route_experiments_ui` is checked at route registration + on page mount to avoid accidentally deep-linking users into a broken experience. - Accessibility: table uses proper <th> headers, keyboard navigation for row selection, and badges have aria-labels for screen readers. Screenshots (internal): - Experiments list (Running + Degraded examples) - Experiment details header with guardrail badges - Empty state with enablement guidance. Testing: - Added unit tests for status mapping + guardrail badge rendering - Added a basic Playwright smoke test for list -> details navigation behind feature flag (skipped in CI when flag disabled; we enable it in test env config). Rollout plan: Ship behind flag to beta allowlist accounts. Once results dashboard is ready, we’ll add an “Results” tab and remove the placeholder copy. Notes: This PR intentionally keeps guardrail rendering low-cardinality and does not add new metrics tags; it reads what the backend provides.

review_conversation: Kenji Nakamura (Design): Copy on the empty state should not mention internal feature flag names; can we say “Contact your admin to enable Route Experiments” and add a docs link placeholder?
Felix Schneider (Author): Yep. I’ll update empty state copy and add a `TODO(docs)` link target behind a config value so we don’t hardcode a URL yet.

Chloe Martin: For degraded/stopping states, please ensure we don’t show the “Stop experiment” button (even disabled) for users without permission; Security asked us to avoid leaking action affordances. Also, list page should not call the details endpoint per-row (saw an N+1 in the network tab).
Felix Schneider (Author): Good catches. Updated the actions section to be permission-scoped and removed the per-row details fetch; the table now uses only the list endpoint fields.

Allison Grant (SRE/Obs): Guardrail badge should include last evaluation timestamp and clarify if values are missing vs healthy. We’ve seen partial attribution causing nulls; UI should show “No data” rather than green.
Felix Schneider (Author): Added explicit “No data” state with neutral styling and tooltip; timestamp is shown in the guardrail card header from the API field.

Dylan Brooks: Overall looks good. Can you add a small perf guard for the list table (virtualization isn’t needed yet, but we should avoid rendering 1000 rows). Maybe cap to 200 and require filters, or paginate.
Felix Schneider (Author): Implemented server-side pagination (pageSize=50) with a “Load more” control; kept it simple until we have the shared pagination component integrated.
Kenji Nakamura (Design): Approving with the updated empty state and neutral “No data” treatment. Please ensure badges align with Console semantic colors (warning vs danger).
Felix Schneider (Author): Updated to use `semantic.warning` for Degraded and `semantic.danger` only for hard-stop/failed states (not present yet).
Chloe Martin: Approved after pagination + removing N+1. Thanks.
release_notes: Console (beta): Adds initial Route Experiments list and details pages behind the route experiments UI feature flag, including status and guardrail snapshot readouts.
